ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound does the Arabic letter خ make? (1 mark)
   A. th as in think
   B. f as in fan
   C. s as in sun
   D. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch

2. What does the Arabic word بَيْضٌ (bayd) mean? (1 mark)
   A. chicken
   B. meat
   C. eggs
   D. carrots

3. What is a class portfolio? (1 mark)
   A. A folder of the class's best work
   B. A single picture
   C. A kind of desk
   D. A test paper

4. What is the name of the Arabic letter ن? (1 mark)
   A. waaw
   B. shiin
   C. taa
   D. nuun

5. How is the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. hadiyya
   B. ʿiid miilaad
   C. raqs
   D. sadiiq

6. Which Arabic sentence means "My grandfather is old (big in age)." (1 mark)
   A. جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   B. أَخِي صَغِيرٌ
   C. مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ
   D. أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ

7. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The lamp is above the table.
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. I am at the door.
   D. The cat is under the bed.

8. In the sentence fii s-sabaah aakulu khubzan wa bayDan, which words show that the meal is in the morning? (1 mark)
   A. aakulu
   B. fii s-sabaah
   C. khubzan
   D. wa bayDan

9. Which is the best answer to kayfa haaluka? (1 mark)
   A. hal ʿindaka hafla?
   B. maʿa s-salaama
   C. ismii Ahmad
   D. anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah

10. What does the Arabic sentence مَا اسْمُكِ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name? (to a girl)
   B. My name is Ahmad.
   C. I am a pupil (girl).
   D. I am a pupil (boy).

11. Which Arabic word means "delicious"? (1 mark)
   A. يَوْمٌ
   B. بِجَانِبِ
   C. لَذِيذٌ
   D. كَعْكَةٌ

12. What does the ending -ii mean in abii and ummii? (1 mark)
   A. my
   B. your
   C. our
   D. his

13. What is the name of the Arabic letter م? (1 mark)
   A. jiim
   B. baa
   C. alif
   D. miim

14. Which sentence means 'The wind is strong'? (1 mark)
   A. al-jawwu ghaa'im
   B. al-jawwu mumtir
   C. ash-shamsu haarra
   D. ar-riihu qawiyya

15. Which phrase do you use to thank the audience? (1 mark)
   A. kayfa haaluka?
   B. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   C. shukran li-istimaaʿikum
   D. maa ismuka?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: ukhtii jamiila (2 marks)

18. Write two describing words in Arabic sounds with their meanings, one for a masculine and one for a feminine item. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'I eat bread and I drink milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Describe how you can make flashcards for the days of the week. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   The letter خ makes the sound kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch.

2. C — eggs
   بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

3. A — A folder of the class's best work
   A portfolio keeps work together to be shown and reviewed.

4. D — nuun
   The letter ن is called nuun.

5. A — hadiyya
   هَدِيَّةٌ is read hadiyya and means gift.

6. A — جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

7. C — I am at the door.
   أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (anaa ʿinda l-baab) means: I am at the door.

8. B — fii s-sabaah
   sabaah means morning, so fii s-sabaah is 'in the morning'.

9. D — anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah
   The question asks how you are, so the answer says 'I am well, thanks be to God'.

10. A — What is your name? (to a girl)
   مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

11. C — لَذِيذٌ
   لَذِيذٌ (ladhiidh) means delicious.

12. A — my
   The ending -ii means 'my', so abii is 'my father' and ummii is 'my mother'.

13. D — miim
   The letter م is called miim.

14. D — ar-riihu qawiyya
   riih is wind and qawiyya is the feminine form of strong.

15. C — shukran li-istimaaʿikum
   shukran li-istimaaʿikum means 'thank you for listening'.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister is beautiful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: kabiir (big) for a masculine word and kabiira (big) for a feminine word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form and 1 mark for the meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: aakulu l-khubza wa ashrabu l-haliiba. I eat bread and I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cut cards; write the Arabic day on the front; write the English name and sound on the back; decorate and display in order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.
